results.title: Christmas Guess the Price Game, 2-20 Players, Digital Download (PDF Guide)
results.description:
🎄 Sticker Shock is a guess the price game suitable for 2 to 20 players, perfect for Christmas. Your digital download includes the game and a how-to guide.

The host opens the game file on a laptop or desktop computer. Everyone else joins on their phone or tablets by scanning a QR code. Playing on phones needs internet access on the host computer and on every phone.

📱 How it works
Open the game file on your laptop. Show it on the laptop screen, connect a TV, or share it on a video call.
Players scan the code with their phone camera to join the game.
The game consists of 5 rounds and takes about 15 to 20 minutes to finish.

🎯 The rounds
🥇 Closest wins: Everyone types a price. The closest guess gets the most points.
↕️ Hi-lo: The screen shows a price. Is the real one higher or lower? You have 8 seconds to tap Higher or Lower.
🛒 Full cart: You are given a budget and six items. Fill your cart without going over the budget.
🤫 Big bluff: Write a fake price that sounds real, then try to find the real price of the item.
🎲 All in: Bet some of your points on one big item, then guess.

💡 Good to know
Each game draws a mix from 48 Christmas themed items, and Play again uses the items you haven't seen in the previous playthrough.
Add up to 10 of your own items before the game starts (optional).
📝 No internet? Choose Paper mode. Players write or say their answers, and the host scores on screen. There is no bluff round.
Prices are typical US prices from October 2026, shown in USD, EUR or GBP. The host picks at the start of the game; euros and pounds are converted at a fixed rate.

💻 What you need
A laptop or desktop computer with an up-to-date browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox). Phones and tablets can't host.
Players need a phone or tablet with an up-to-date browser (Safari, Chrome or Firefox).
For a TV, an HDMI cable from the laptop. Some laptops need an adapter.

📦 What you get
1. Sticker-Shock-Christmas.zip with the game file. Unzip it and double-click the file. The game opens in your browser.
2. A two-page buyer guide (PDF).
Download the files after Etsy confirms payment: from the link in your email, or Purchases on etsy.com in a browser. The Etsy app doesn't show downloads.

🤝 Returns and help
Digital items aren't eligible for ordinary returns or exchanges. If your files are missing or the game doesn't match this description, message me on Etsy. Etsy's case process and your consumer rights still apply.

📄 License: one household or one office party host. Please don't share the file publicly.
Designed by Denon Creative. AI tools helped build the game and draw its doodles.

❓ Questions
Does it work on a TV? Yes, from a laptop connected by HDMI. Casting from a phone and smart TV browsers aren't supported.
Can we play over a video call? Yes. Share your screen, and remote players join with the room code.
Can more than 20 people play? A room holds 20 phones. Pairs can share a phone.
